# Mercedes Garage Dubai

> Independent Mercedes-Benz specialist workshop in Al Quoz, Dubai, UAE. Dealer-level XENTRY diagnostics, routine servicing, mechanical and electrical repair, AMG performance maintenance, facelift conversions, and custom body kit upgrades. Certified German car technicians. 15+ years of Mercedes-Benz expertise.

Mercedes Garage Dubai (also known as German Auto Expert) is a premier independent automotive workshop dedicated exclusively to Mercedes-Benz passenger cars and AMG performance vehicles. Located in Al Quoz Industrial Area 2, the workshop utilizes factory-grade XENTRY diagnostic computers, genuine OEM parts, and certified German car technicians.

**A:** Yes. Mercedes Garage Dubai is a Mercedes-Benz specialist workshop. Our technicians focus exclusively on Mercedes-Benz and AMG repair, maintenance, and modification.

### Q: What Mercedes models do you service?

**A:** Monday to Saturday, 9:00 AM to 8:00 PM. Closed on Sunday. For emergencies, call +971 56 788 8808.

### Q: Do you offer AMG performance upgrades?
**A:** Yes. We offer AMG performance upgrades including brake caliper painting, suspension upgrades, custom exhaust systems, and wide-body styling conversions at our Dubai workshop.
